description: List the items (tiles, stations, time slices) of a data.geo.admin.ch STAC collection with their downloadable assets (href, media type, size), plus collection-level assets (e.g. MeteoSwiss station/parameter metadata CSVs). Filter by WGS84 bbox, datetime or a single item id; asset_filter narrows asset keys. Examples: collection='ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-smn', item_id='ber' (Bern-Zollikofen station), asset_filter='_d_' (daily data); collection='ch.swisstopo.swissalti3d', bbox=[7.43,46.94,7.46,46.96]. Next: read_geodata_asset on a CSV/JSON href.

asset_filter.description: Only assets whose key/title contains this text, e.g. '.csv', '_h_recent', '2m'

bbox.description: WGS84 bbox [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat], e.g. [7.43, 46.94, 7.46, 46.96]

item_id.description: Fetch one item by id (e.g. a MeteoSwiss station abbreviation in lower case, 'ber')

page_url.description: The 'next_page_url' from a previous call, to continue paging

name: get_geodata_collection_items
title: List items and downloadable assets of a STAC collection
